input: I took my nephew Theo to the fall fair today and we shared a paper cone of mini donuts on the bleachers by the tractor pull.
On the drive home we talked about renting a canoe at Alouette Lake before it gets too cold, the way my uncle used to take me.
What did I tell you about the fall fair?
Actually, all I want to know is who I went with.
And what was it we said about the canoe?
Never mind that. Is it too late in the year to plan the lake trip?
